article_content: Current and former members of the Penn State football program offered condolences Sunday following the death of legendary former head coach Joe Paterno. The Penn State Board of Trustees and University President Rodney Erickson stated: 'We grieve the loss of Joe Paterno, a great man who made us a greater university. His dedication to ensuring his players succeeded both on the field and in life is legendary, and his commitment to education is unmatched in college football. His life, work, and generosity will always be remembered. The University plans to honor him for his many contributions and to celebrate his remarkable legacy. We are all deeply saddened and are considering appropriate ways to honor his life. The Department of Intercollegiate Athletics is consulting with members of the Penn State community regarding the nature and timing of tributes.' Bill O'Brien, Penn State’s head football coach, said: 'It is with great sadness that I share this message of condolence and tribute to a great man, husband, father, and someone who was more than just a coach—Joe Paterno. On behalf of Penn State Football, we offer our sincerest condolences to the Paterno family. We also extend our sympathies to the entire Penn State community, especially those who wore the Nittany Lions colors—our players and alumni. Today, they lost a great man, coach, mentor, and in many cases, a father figure. The Penn State football program is iconic because it was led by an icon of the coaching profession. No words can express my respect for him as a man and a coach. Following in his footsteps at Penn State is an honor. Our families, our program, our university, and all of college football have suffered a tremendous loss. We will be eternally grateful for Coach Paterno’s immeasurable contributions.' Jerry Sandusky, former Penn State assistant coach at the center of the child sex abuse scandal that led to Paterno’s dismissal last year, said: 'This is a sad day. My wife, Dottie, and I offer our deepest sympathies to Sue and her family. No one did more for the academic reputation of Penn State than Joe Paterno. He upheld high standards in a very difficult profession. Joe preached toughness, hard work, and clean competition—and most importantly, he had the courage to live by those values. No one can take away the memories we all shared of a great man, his family, and the countless people who were part of his life.' Tim Curley, former Penn State Athletic Director who took a leave of absence during the abuse scandal, said: 'Words cannot express the sorrow my family and I feel. Joe has been an integral part of my life for over 35 years. He coached me, mentored me, and taught me what it means to compete with integrity and honor. Above all, he demonstrated every day the power of humility. Our thoughts, prayers, and sincere condolences go out to the Paterno family.' Gary Schultz, former Penn State vice president who retired amid the scandal, said: 'With profound sadness, my family and I express our heartfelt condolences to the Paterno family. I had the sincere honor and distinct pleasure of working with Joe for many years at Penn State. No one loved Penn State more than Joe. We will all miss him.' Former President George H.W. Bush said: 'I was deeply saddened to hear of the passing of Joe Paterno. He was an outstanding American, respected not only on the field but in life—and without a doubt, a true icon in the world of sports. I was proud to call him a friend. Barbara and I send our condolences to his devoted wife, Sue, and his wonderful family.' Pennsylvania Attorney General Linda Kelly said: 'The Paterno family is in our thoughts and prayers as they mourn the loss of a beloved husband and father. Few people have touched so many lives the way Joe Paterno did. Today, we extend our heartfelt condolences to his family during this difficult time.' Nick Saban, head football coach at the University of Alabama, said: 'Joe Paterno gave his life to college football—to the players and the game. I never doubted that he would always do what was best for college football and its athletes. That should be his legacy.'

Njegova posvećenost osiguranju da su njegovi igrači bili uspješni i na terenu i u životu legendaran je, a njegova obaveza prema obrazovanju nema jednakih u kolleškom fudbalu. Razmišljamo o odgovarajućim načinima da počastimo njegov veliki život i naslijeđe. Odjel za međufakultetski sport savjetuje se s članovima zajednice Penn State-a o prirodi i vremenu skupštine.' Bill O'Brien, trenutni trener fudbalskog tima Penn State-a, rekao je: 'Sa velikom žalosti moram da dostavim poruku sažaljenja i počasti velikom čovjeku, mužu, ocu i nekom tko je bio više od trenera—Joe Paterno-u. U ime fudbalskog tima Penn State-a, šaljemo najsrdačnija sažaljenja obitelji Paterno. Također šaljemo sažaljenja cijeloj zajednici Penn State-a, a posebno svim onima koji su nosili boje Penn State-a—našim igračima i alumnom. Danas su izgubili velikog čovjeka, trenera, mentora i u mnogim slučajevima oca, i šaljemo im duboke simpatije. Fudbalski program Penn State-a je jedan od ikoničnih programa kolleškog fudbala jer ga je vodila ikona u trenerskom zanimanju—Joe Paterno. Ne postoje riječi koje bi mogle izraziti moju poštovanje prema njemu kao čovjeku i treneru. Sljediti njegove korake na Penn State-u je čast. Naše obitelji, naš fudbalski program, naš univerzitet i sav kolleški fudbal doživjeli su ogroman gubitak, i bit ćemo vječno zahvalni za neprocjenjive doprinose trenera Paterno-a.' Jerry Sandusky, bivši pomoćni trener Penn State-a koji je bio u centru skandala o seksualnom zlostavljanju djece koji je doveo do njegove otpuštanja prošle godine, rekao je: 'Ovo je žalosan dan! Moja obitelj, Dottie i ja, želimo izraziti najdublje sažaljenje Sue i njoj obitelji. Niko nije učinio više za akademsku reputaciju Penn State-a nego Joe Paterno. On je održavao visok standard u vrlo teškom zanimanju. Joe je propovijedao tvrdinu, težak rad i čisto natjecanje. Najvažnije, imao je hrabrosti da praksa ono što je propovijedao. Niko neće moći ukloniti sjećanja koja smo svi dijelili o velikom čovjeku, njegovoj obitelji i svim divnim ljudima koji su bili dio njegovog života.' Tim Curley, bivši direktor athletike Penn State-a koji je otišao na dopust tijekom skandala o seksualnom zlostavljanju, rekao je: 'Riječi ne mogu izraziti žalost koju osjećaju moja obitelj i ja. Joe je bio integralni dio mog života više od 35 godina. Joe me trening, mentorirao, naučio što znači natjecati s integritetom i čašću, i najviše pokazao svakim danom koji je živio, snagu skromnosti. Naše misli, molitve i srdačna sažaljenja idu obitelji Paterno.' Gary Schultz, bivši potpredsjednik Penn State-a koji se penzionirao tijekom skandala o seksualnom zlostavljanju, rekao je: 'Sa dubokom žalosti, moja obitelj i ja želimo izraziti srdačna sažaljenja obitelji Paterno danas. Imali sam iskrenu čast i posebnu radost da radim s Joe-om godinama na Penn State-u. Niko nije volio Penn State više od Joe-a. Svi ćemo ga nedostajati.' Bivši predsjednik George H.W. Bush rekao je: 'Duboko sam žalio čuti o smrti Joe Paterno-a. Bio je izvanredan Amerikanac koji je bio poštovan ne samo na terenu, već i u životu općenito—i bio je, bez sumnje, pravi ikona u svijetu sporta. Bio sam ponosan što je bio moj prijatelj. Barbara i ja šaljemo sažaljenja njegovoj posvećenoj supruzi Sue i njegovoj divnoj obitelji.' Pravobranitelj Pensilvanije Linda Kelly rekla je: 'Obitelji Paterno su u našim mislima i molitvama dok žale gubitak ljubljenog muža i oca. Malo ljudi je uticalo na živote toliko drugih kao što je Joe Paterno. Danas šaljemo srdačna sažaljenja njegovoj obitelji u ovom teškom vremenu.' Nick Saban, trener fudbalskog tima nacionalnog prvaka University of Alabama, rekao je: 'Joe Paterno je dao svoj život kolleškom fudbalu. Dao je svoj život igračima i kolleškom fudbalu... Nikad nisam sumnjao da će on učiniti ono što je najbolje za kolleški fudbal i igrače koji su ga igrali, i mislim da to treba biti njegovo naslijeđe.'

article_content: For actor Harrison Ford, who is starring in the movie adaptation of Orson Scott Card’s acclaimed and widely read novel 'Ender’s Game,' statements opposing same-sex marriage by the science-fiction author 'are not an issue for me.' At a Comic-Con news conference on Thursday, Ford addressed concerns that Card’s comments had overshadowed the film’s production. The author of the 1985 novel expressed opposition to same-sex marriage in 2009 when he joined the board of the National Organization for Marriage, which opposes same-sex unions. Although Card later issued a statement calling the issue of same-sex marriage 'moot' following last month’s Supreme Court ruling that struck down a key provision of the Defense of Marriage Act, the film has continued to face controversy. Ford told reporters that while he fundamentally disagrees with Card’s views, the film stands apart from them. 'I think none of Mr. Card’s concerns regarding gay marriage are part of the thematic core of this film,' Ford said. 'He has written something I believe holds value for all of us regarding moral responsibility. His personal views outside this context are not my concern — and frankly, I have no opinion on them.' Ford added: 'I am aware that he has admitted the question of gay marriage is a battle he lost — and he acknowledges that he lost it. I think we all know we’ve all won. Humanity has won. And I think that’s the end of the story.' For Ford, 'Ender’s Game' engages with its own social and political questions. Set in the future, the film depicts a child trained by the government to wage interplanetary war. Ford plays Col. Hyrum Graff, the military commander who trains Ender Wiggin, portrayed by Asa Butterfield. Though the movie unfolds in a science fiction setting, Ford noted strong parallels to contemporary moral dilemmas. 'This movie is very prescient,' Ford said. 'The novel recognized something we now live with daily: the ability to wage war at a distance. The morality of military command structures, and of societies that raise children to fight, are the core concerns of this film — and we wrestle with them every day.' 'The idea of interplanetary warfare is science fiction — but what gives it emotional weight and realism is that these are issues from our everyday lives. Drone warfare and technological capability form one part of this moral equation. The other is the use of young people in war — a historical constant. Our youngest and fittest have always been the first sent into battle.' Ford, who praised working with talented young actors like Butterfield and Hailee Steinfeld, as well as Sir Ben Kingsley, was also asked if Col. Graff resembled his iconic 'Star Wars' character, Han Solo. 'Graff is a far more complex character, burdened with immense moral responsibility,' Ford explained. 'Ender doesn’t fully confront moral consequences until the end — when he realizes what he’s done. Graff understands his duty throughout. I was thrilled to be part of a film with such ambition and such gifted people. Graff is more complex than Han Solo — but that doesn’t mean I regret playing Han Solo.' 'Ender’s Game' is scheduled for theatrical release on November 1. Summit Entertainment released a new viral clip and premiered a trailer during the Comic-Con fan panel.

Na konferenciji za novinare na Comic-Conu u četvrtak, Ford je odgovorio na zabrinutost da su Cardove izjave zasjenile produkciju filma. Autor romana iz 1985. godine izjavio je da se suprotstavlja istospolnom braku 2009. godine kada se pridružio Savjetu Nacionalne organizacije za brak, koja se suprotstavlja istospolnim unijama. Ford je rekao novinarima da iako temeljno ne slaže s Cardovim stavovima, film je odvojen od tog pitanja. 'Mislim da nijedna od Cardovih briga vezanih uz homoseksualni brak nije deo tematskog jezgra ovog filma,' rekao je Ford. 'Napisao je nešto što, mislim, ima vrijednost za sve nas kada je riječ o moralnoj odgovornosti. Njegovi lični stavovi izvan ovog konteksta nisu moj problem — i iskreno, nemam mišljenje o tome.' I mislim da je to kraj priče.' Za Forda, 'Enderova igra' obrađuje vlastite društvene i političke pitanja. Radnja se odvija u budućnosti, gdje se dijete obučava od strane vlade kako bi vodilo međuplanetarni rat. Ford tumači kolonela Hyruma Graffa, vojnog zapovjednika koji obučava tituliranog lika Endera Wiggina, koji tumači Asa Butterfield. Iako se film odvija u naučno-fantastičnom svijetu, Ford je primjetio jaku paralelu sa današnjim moralnim dilemama. 'Ovaj film je veoma predvidljiv,' rekao je Ford. 'Roman je prepoznao nešto što danas živimo svakodnevno: sposobnost vođenja rata na daljinu. Moralnost vojnih zapovjednih struktura i društava koja obučavaju djecu za rat su srž ovog filma — i bavimo se njima svaki dan.' 'Ideja međuplanetarnog rata je naučna fantastika — ali ono što mu daje emocionalnu težinu i realnost je da su ovo pitanja iz našeg svakodnevnog života. Rat droneova i tehnološka mogućnost su jedan dio ovog moralnog paketa. Drugi je korištenje mladih ljudi u ratu — povijesna konstanta. Naši najmlađi i najjači uvijek su bili prvi koji su poslani u rat.' Ford, koji je cijenio rad s talentiranim mladim glumcima poput Butterfielda i Hailee Steinfeld, kao i Sir Ben Kingsley, također je pitao je li video ikakvu paralelu između kolonela Graffa i njegovog ikoničnog lika iz 'Zvjezdanih staza', Hana Soloa. 'Graff je mnogo složeniji lik, opterećen ogromnom moralnom odgovornošću,' objasnio je Ford. 'Ender ne suočava moralne posljedice dok ne dođe do kraja filma — kada shvati šta je učinio. Graff razumije svoju dužnost cijelo vrijeme. Bio sam oduševljen što sam bio dio filma s takvim ambicijama i toliko darovitih ljudi. Graff je složeniji od Hana Soloa — ali to ne znači da žalim što sam igrao Hana Soloa.' 'Enderova igra' je zakazana za prikazivanje u bioskopima 1. studenoga. Summit Entertainment objavila je novi viralni klip i premijerno je prikazala trailer tijekom fan panela na Comic-Conu.

article_content: Once dismissed as a cold, soulless eyesore, Metro Central Heights — a massive concrete complex in London’s Elephant and Castle — has officially been recognized as a nationally important piece of post-war architecture. Despite decades of criticism, including being labeled one of the worst examples of 1960s urban design, the building has now been granted Grade II listed status by Heritage Minister Ed Vaizey. Designed by Hungarian-born architect Ernö Goldfinger between 1959 and 1967, the structure was originally called Alexander Fleming House and served as the headquarters for the Department of Health and Social Security. But by the late 1980s, it gained a grim reputation: tenants reported health issues linked to poor air quality and design flaws — a phenomenon known as 'sick building syndrome.' Staff were relocated in the early 1990s, and the building stood empty for over a decade, even facing threats of demolition. In 2002, it found new life as a residential tower, and over time, public opinion began to shift. Today, architects and heritage experts argue that its bold, monolithic form represents a bold vision of modernist urban living — one that influenced later high-rise designs across Britain. Goldfinger himself considered this project one of his proudest accomplishments. His uncompromising style — stark, functional, and unapologetically modern — earned him both admiration and enemies. Most famously, novelist Ian Fleming, who resented Goldfinger’s demolition of historic cottages in Hampstead to build his own home, retaliated by naming a ruthless villain after him: Auric Goldfinger. Legend has it Fleming initially planned to call the villain 'Goldprick' before settling on the more elegant (and sinister) name. Though controversial, Goldfinger’s legacy endures. His Trellick Tower in West London, once similarly hated by locals, is now a celebrated icon. English Heritage and the Design Museum acknowledge that while his buildings divided opinion at first, they’ve since proven their lasting cultural and architectural value. Listing doesn’t lock the building in amber — owners can still modify or even demolish parts of it, but only with official approval. In essence, the designation honors its history, not its perfection.
translated_content: Jednom odbačen kao hladan, duševno prazan očni bol, Metro Central Heights — ogroman betonski kompleks u Londonu u Elephant and Castle — je službeno priznat kao nacionalno važan dio poslijeratne arhitekture. Unatoč decenijama kritike, uključujući označavanje kao jednog od najgorih primjera urbanog dizajna iz 1960-ih, zgrada je sada dobila status liste druge kategorije (Grade II) od strane ministra nasljeđa Eda Vaizeya. Projektirana mađarsko-rođenim arhitektom Ernö Goldfingerom između 1959. i 1967. godine, zgrada je izvorno bila poznata kao Alexander Fleming House i služila kao sjedište Ministarstva zdravstva i socijalne sigurnosti. Ali do kasnih 1980-ih, stekla je mrzovoljan ugled: stanari su prijavljivali zdravstvene probleme povezane s lošom kvalitetom zraka i arhitektonskim nedostacima — pojavu poznatu kao 'sindrom bolesne zgrade'. Zaposlenici su prebačeni početkom 1990-ih, a zgrada je ostala prazna više od deset godina, čak i suočena s prijetnjama demoliranja. U 2002. godini, našla je novi život kao stambena zgrada, a tokom vremena javno mišljenje se počelo mijenjati. Danas arhitekte i stručnjaci za nasljeđe tvrde da njen boldan, monolitni oblik predstavlja smjelu viziju modernističkog urbanih života — jednu koja je uticala na kasnije visokonadzemne projekte širom Britanije. Goldfinger sam je smatrao ovaj projekt jednim od svojih najvećih dostignuća. Njegov nepopustljiv stil — strogo funkcionalan i neizbježno modern — donio mu je i priznanje i neprijatelje. Najpoznatije, književnik Ian Fleming, koji je mrzio Goldfingerovo rušenje povijesnih kućica u Hampsteadu kako bi sagradio svoju vlastitu kuću, odmazdao je tako što je nazvao zloglasnog lika po njemu: Auric Goldfinger. Legenda kaže da je Fleming prvobitno planirao nazvati lik 'Goldprick', ali se na kraju odlučio za elegantniji (i sinisterniji) naziv. Iako kontroverzan, Goldfingerov nasljeđe traje. Njegova Trellick Tower na zapadu Londona, koja je isto tako bila mržena od strane lokalaca, danas je slavni ikon. English Heritage i Design Museum priznaju da su njegove zgrade bile podijeljene na početku, ali su se kasnije dokazale kao trajne kulturne i arhitektonske vrijednosti. Lista ne znači da je zgrada zapečaćena u vremenu — vlasnici mogu i dalje mijenjati ili čak demontirati dijelove zgrade, ali samo sa službenom dozvolom. Suština ovog priznanja je slavljenje njezine povijesti, a ne njezine savršenosti.

article_content: CNN — Brazilian legend Pelé once called soccer the 'beautiful game.' At its best, it showcases the pinnacle of human endeavor, uniting nations and communities in support of their teams and heroes. Yet, at its worst, it reveals the darkest sides of human behavior — amplified by intense media scrutiny and the fallibility of our sporting icons. In celebration of this 'dark side,' CNN presents its First XI of soccer villains from the last decade. Three of them — Zinedine Zidane, Thierry Henry, and Luis Figo — are also among the game’s greatest heroes, illustrating how triumph and disaster are twin imposters. (See our First XI of soccer heroes.) Perhaps these actions can be excused under the crushing pressure of modern football — where victory or a transfer to a rival club, as in Figo’s case — one of history’s most infamous betrayals — brings riches beyond the dreams of ordinary fans. Here is Fanzone’s selected Eleven of the Noughties’ soccer villains. Let us know what you think by commenting below. 1. Zinedine Zidane: The midfield maestro tops both our heroes and villains lists for his infamous headbutt on Italy’s Marco Materazzi during extra time of the 2006 World Cup final. It was his final match; sent off, France lost the penalty shootout — a tragic end to a glittering career. 2. Thierry Henry: Entering France’s 2009 World Cup qualifying playoff against Ireland as one of the world’s most respected players, Henry’s reputation crumbled after a deliberate handball led to the decisive goal. The incident ignited a global debate on sportsmanship. He faced widespread condemnation and anticipated hostility at the 2010 World Cup. 3. Rivaldo: The Brazilian midfielder was instrumental in Brazil’s 2002 World Cup triumph with his elegant play. But his blatant dive to feign injury against Turkey — resulting in a red card for Hakan Şanlı — was widely condemned and remains one of the most notorious examples of simulation in tournament history. 4. Luis Figo: Once adored by Barcelona fans during his five-year tenure, Figo became public enemy No. 1 after his 2000 transfer to arch-rivals Real Madrid for a world-record fee. In a 2002 El Clásico, a severed pig’s head was thrown onto the pitch at him. He was never forgiven and spent his final years at Inter Milan. 5. Roy Keane: The Manchester United enforcer deliberately injured Alfe-Inge Haaland of city rivals Manchester City in a 2001 derby, ending a long-standing feud. Keane later admitted he intended to hurt Haaland in retaliation. He received a lengthy ban but showed no remorse. 6. Adrian Mutu: The Chelsea striker was immediately dismissed after testing positive for cocaine. The club then successfully sued him for breach of contract, seeking a record $25 million in damages. Multiple appeals have failed, leaving Mutu financially devastated for a momentary lapse. 7. Robert Hoyzer: The German referee admitted to colluding with an international betting syndicate to fix matches, including a German Cup game involving SV Hamburg. He was sentenced to over two years in prison, casting a shadow over the Bundesliga. 8. Joey Barton: Once seen as England’s rising star, Barton’s violent off-field behavior culminated in a six-month jail sentence in 2008 for a 'cowardly' assault in Liverpool — a stark contrast to his on-field prominence. 9. Zheng Zhi: Though popular in English football, Zheng’s conduct elsewhere drew criticism: he received a six-month ban from the AFC Champions League for spitting at a referee and caused Djibril Cissé’s broken leg with a reckless challenge during the 2006 World Cup. 10. René Higuita: Famous for his 'Scorpion Kick' against England, the Colombian keeper later fell into controversy after testing positive for cocaine and being banned from Ecuadorian club football. He remains close friends with Diego Maradona. 11. Diego Maradona: While relatively quiet in the 2000s, Maradona’s past caught up with him as health issues mounted. As Argentina’s national coach, he led them to a dramatic 2010 World Cup qualification — only to be temporarily banned by FIFA for verbally abusing reporters after the decisive match.

Joey Barton: Newcastleov Barton je izgledao kao da ima svijet na stopalima kada je nastupio za Englesku, ali postojala je tamnija strana ovog borbenog srednjeg igrača, sa prijavama o borbi sa drugim igračima čak i sa navijačima. Zheng Zhi: Kineski kapetan Zheng Zhi dokazao je da je popularan igrač u engleskom nogometu, ali njegovi doprinosi drugdje su više pitanjno. René Higuita: Bivši kolumbijski golman postao je poznat po svom 'Škorpionskom udarcu' protiv Engleske, ali u posljednjim godinama je postao kontroverzna figura i bio je zabranjen u ekvadorskom klubskom nogometu nakon pozitivnog testa na kokain. Diego Maradona: Po standardima devedesetih, ovo je bilo tiho desetljeće za argentinskog nogometnog legende, a svijet je držao dah dok su medicinski problemi, gotovo sigurno povezani s njegovom bohemskom prošlošću, stigli do njega. article_content: Photoshopping an image may seem like a modern phenomenon, but the practice of editing photographs dates back to the 1940s. In 1946, Harry LeRoy Adams, a Colorado-based inventor, created and patented the Adam’s Retouching Machine — an early mechanical device designed to refine photographic negatives before development. Weighing 16 kilograms (two-and-a-half stone), the machine featured a magnifying glass, a specialized retouching pencil, and a gently vibrating platform. Photographers placed the negative on a green cloth at the center of the device, which was backlit by a fluorescent tube. Using the pencil with precision, they could smooth blemishes or correct flaws, aided by the machine’s subtle vibrations to ensure even strokes. In today’s currency, the device sold for approximately $2,300 (£1,435), making it a premium tool accessible only to professional retouchers. The patent, filed in March 1946 and granted in June 1947, described the invention as a means to automate microscopic retouching marks, reducing the need for extreme manual skill and saving considerable time. Decades later, John Sargent Barnard, a 27-year-old photographer and vintage camera dealer from San Francisco, acquired one of these machines for just $5 (£3) on an online auction site. He spent hours cleaning decades of accumulated grime and replaced only the faulty lightbulb to restore functionality. Despite his expertise, Barnard admitted he couldn’t master the technique. 'I ruined several negatives,' he said. 'My hands weren’t steady enough, and I didn’t have the right pencil — it demands surgical precision.' After restoring the machine, Barnard sold it to a private collector in New York for an undisclosed sum. 'People thought I was crazy for buying it,' he recalled. 'They said it looked like a giant paperweight.' He hoped it would find a home in a photography studio, but its ultimate use remains unknown.
translated_content: Fotografisanje slike može izgledati kao savremena pojava, ali praksa uređivanja fotografija datira još iz 1940-ih. Godine 1946., Harry LeRoy Adams, izumitelj iz Kolorada, izumio je i patentirao uređaj Adam’s Retouching Machine — raniji mehanički uređaj dizajniran da unaprijeđuje fotografske negativne snimke prije razvoja. Težak 16 kilograma (dva i pol kamena), uređaj je imao povećalo, specijaliziranu olovku za retuširanje i lagano vibrirajuću platformu. Fotografi su stavljali negativ na zelenu tkaninu u sredini uređaja, koji je bio osvijetljen fluorescentnom cijevi. Koristeći olovku s preciznošću, mogli su glatko ukloniti nedostatke ili ispraviti greške, uz pomoć sitnih vibracija uređaja kako bi se osigurala ravnomjerna kretanja. U današnjem novcu, uređaj je prodavan za otprilike 2.300 dolara (1.435 funti), što ga čini premium alatom dostupnim samo profesionalnim retušerima. Patent, podnijet u martu 1946. i dodijeljen u juni 1947., opisivao je izum kao sredstvo za automatizaciju mikroskopskih oznaka retuširanja, smanjujući potrebu za ekstremnim ručnim vještinama i uštedujući značajno vrijeme. Decenije kasnije, John Sargent Barnard, 27-godišnji fotograf i trgovac starijim fotoaparatom iz San Franciska, kupio je jedan od ovih uređaja za samo 5 dolara (3 funte) na internetskom aukcijskom sajtu. Proveo je sati čisteći desetljećima nagomilanu prljavštinu i zamijenio samo pokvarenu žarulju kako bi obnovio funkcionalnost. Unatoč svojoj stručnosti, Barnard je priznao da nije uspio savladati tehniku. 'Pokvario sam nekoliko negativa,' rekao je. 'Moje ruke nisu bile dovoljno stabilne, a nisam imao pravu olovku — zahtijeva kiruršku preciznost.' Nakon obnove uređaja, Barnard ga je prodao privatnom kolekcionaru u New Yorku za neotkriven iznos. 'Ljudi su mislili da sam lud zbog kupovine ovog uređaja,' sjetio se. 'Rekli su da izgleda kao ogroman papirni teg.' Nadao se da će pronaći dom u fotografskoj radnji, ali njegova konačna namjena ostaje nepoznata.

article_content: Indonesia’s Financial Services Authority (OJK) announced on Friday that it will phase down the maximum daily interest rates charged by fintech lenders in the microfinance sector, responding to widespread concerns that excessively high rates are harming borrowers. Starting in 2024, the cap on daily interest for consumption loans will drop from the current 0.4% to 0.3%, and further to 0.1% by 2026. For loans used for productive purposes—such as funding micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs)—the cap will be set at 0.1% beginning January 2024, with potential reductions beyond that by 2026. The OJK aims to shift the composition of fintech lending so that 50% to 70% of total loans support productive economic activity by 2028, up from under 40% today. 'If we don’t regulate interest rates properly, those who suffer most are the consumers,' said Agusman, OJK commissioner responsible for financing firms, during a press briefing. The move is part of a broader 2023–2028 strategy to stabilize and formalize Indonesia’s rapidly growing fintech lending market, which expanded sharply after the COVID-19 pandemic but has been marred by fraudulent operators and borrower distress.
translated_content: Indonezijska vlast za financijske usluge (OJK) je u petak objavila da će postepeno smanjiti maksimalne dnevne kamatne stope koje naplaćuju fintech kompanije u sektoru mikrofinansiranja, kao odgovor na široko rasprostranjene zabrinutosti da izuzetno visoke kamate štete pozajmioacima. Od 2024. godine, ograničenje dnevne kamate za potrošačke zajmove smanjiće se sa trenutnih 0,4% na 0,3%, a zatim na 0,1% do 2026. godine. Za zajmove koji se koriste za proizvodne svrhe — poput finansiranja mikro, malih i srednjih preduzeća (MSSP) — ograničenje će biti postavljeno na 0,1% počevši od januara 2024. godine, sa mogućim daljim smanjenjima do 2026. godine. Ova akcija je deo šire strategije 2023–2028. godine za stabilizaciju i formalizaciju brzo rastućeg tržišta fintech pozajmica u Indoneziji, koje se naglo proširilo nakon pandemije COVID-19, ali je bilo ometano nezakonitim operatorima i poteškoćama pozajmioaca.

article_content: Pollsters predict a landslide victory for the Scottish National Party (SNP) in Scotland’s upcoming general election, a result that could prevent Ed Miliband from becoming Prime Minister. A new survey reveals the SNP maintains steady support at 45%, while Labour trails by 17 percentage points. Remarkably, despite only 15% of Scottish voters supporting the Conservatives, more Scots prefer David Cameron as Prime Minister than Miliband — 23% to 19%. If current trends hold until May 7, the SNP is projected to win 47 seats in Scotland, reducing Labour to just 10 and the Liberal Democrats to only 2. The Conservatives would retain their single Scottish seat. This dramatic shift would leave Labour an estimated 31 seats short of a parliamentary majority nationally, with only 290 Westminster seats projected overall. Even a coalition with the Lib Dems — expected to win just 24 seats nationwide — would still leave Labour seven seats short of a working majority. Experts warn that such a scenario could destabilize efforts to form a stable government. Labour has criticized David Cameron for appearing to benefit from SNP gains, suggesting he sees their rise as his best path to remaining in power. Shadow Scottish Secretary Margaret Curran accused him of 'talking up' the SNP and 'talking down' Labour ahead of the Scottish Conservative conference. Yet Cameron has expressed concern that an SNP-backed Labour government could threaten the unity of the United Kingdom, telling the BBC: 'You could have a Labour government propped up by a party that actually wants to abolish our country.' Among Labour’s own supporters in Scotland, only 46% believe Miliband would make the best Prime Minister. Meanwhile, the SNP’s rise has sparked intense debate over whether voting for them inadvertently helps Cameron stay in office — a dynamic Labour warns could backfire, while Cameron views as politically dangerous.

article_content: Customers of Comcast have reported disturbing incidents in which customer service representatives altered their names on billing statements and online accounts with vulgar and degrading labels. Among those affected were Lisa and Ricardo Brown of Spokane, Washington, who received a bill addressed to 'A**hole Brown' after attempting to cancel their $60 monthly cable service due to financial hardship. Similarly, Julie Swano found her name changed to 'Whore' Julia Swano; Carolina Heredia’s account displayed 'Hello, dummy'; and Sako Bezdjian’s parents had their surname altered to 'Fakoe Bez'—a deliberate misspelling meant to mimic a racial slur. These cases were brought to public attention by consumer advocate Christopher Elliot, who published the complaints on his blog. The revelations followed a previous apology from Comcast after a customer was verbally called 'A**hole Brown' during a phone call. When Lisa Brown sought to correct the offensive label, she encountered resistance. Comcast initially responded by waiving the cancellation fee—a move Brown deemed insufficient. 'This is unacceptable,' she said. 'I want everything back I paid Comcast for doing this to me.' In response, Comcast issued formal apologies. Steve Kipp, Vice President of Communications for the Washington region, called the incidents 'completely unacceptable.' Senior Vice President of Customer Service Tom Karinshak confirmed the company had terminated the subcontracting firm responsible for the 'A**hole' case and is implementing new safeguards—including retraining staff and developing automated systems—to prevent future unauthorized name changes. Comcast has also pledged to contact every affected customer personally, offer full refunds where applicable, and do 'whatever it takes to make things right.' The company acknowledges these actions represent a severe breach of trust and is taking steps to rebuild credibility.

article_content: House Speaker John Boehner’s planned lawsuit against President Barack Obama is just a 'stunt,' Obama told ABC News anchor George Stephanopoulos on Thursday. Obama said he had already spoken with the GOP legislator, telling him, 'If you’re truly concerned about me taking too many executive actions, why don’t you try getting something done through Congress?' 'You're going to complain if I try to fix some parts of the law administratively—within my legal authority—while you're doing nothing?' Obama said, referring to House Republicans. 'I'm not going to apologize for trying to act while they're sitting idle.' On Wednesday, Boehner announced he intends to file a lawsuit against President Obama, alleging a pattern of executive overreach. 'This is not about impeachment,' Boehner insisted. 'It's about ensuring the president faithfully executes the laws of this country.' 'Over the past five years, we've clearly seen an effort to erode the power of the legislative branch,' Boehner said. 'I believe the president is not faithfully executing the laws of our country.' The White House has stated it will not let the lawsuit distract from its work. Obama continued his schedule, delivering remarks on the economy in Minneapolis before returning to Washington. Obama has repeatedly promoted his 'pen and phone' strategy to advance his domestic agenda, particularly after Congress failed to act. In his 2014 State of the Union address, he declared 2014 a 'year of action.' While the House has passed bills to limit presidential executive powers—arguing they exceed constitutional bounds—Senate Majority Leader Harry Reid dismissed them as dead on arrival. Among Obama’s most controversial executive actions are: raising the minimum wage for federal contractors, delaying key provisions of the Affordable Care Act, setting new fuel-economy standards for trucks, and directing the EPA to enforce sweeping carbon emissions rules under his Climate Action Plan—which critics call a 'coal-killer' due to its impact on coal-powered plants. But the most contentious move for Boehner’s caucus, according to Capitol Hill sources, is Obama’s 2012 DACA policy, which deferred deportation for hundreds of thousands of undocumented immigrants brought to the U.S. as children. Republicans argue this policy encouraged a surge of unaccompanied minors crossing the southern border, straining government resources and triggering a humanitarian crisis. Boehner has not yet specified which executive actions he will challenge in court. 'When I make that decision, I’ll let you know,' he told reporters. He outlined his intentions in a memo to House Republicans and confirmed his commitment in a closed-door meeting. The lawsuit, if pursued, would be filed by the full House of Representatives, requiring approval from the Bipartisan Legal Advisory Group (BLAG)—a panel composed of Boehner, Majority Leader Kevin McCarthy, Majority Whip Steve Scalise, Minority Leader Nancy Pelosi, and Minority Whip Steny Hoyer. A simple majority vote, likely 3-2, would authorize the suit. White House Press Secretary Josh Earnest criticized Republicans for obstructionism, saying they left Obama no choice but to use executive authority. 'The fact that they are considering a taxpayer-funded lawsuit against the President of the United States for doing his job—I think most Americans wouldn’t support that,' Earnest said. Boehner’s spokesperson, Michael Steel, pushed back, stating: 'The American people, their elected representatives, and the Supreme Court have all expressed serious concerns about the president’s failure to follow the Constitution. Dismissing them with words like 'stunt' only deepens their frustration.' Fox News host Neil Cavuto called the lawsuit politically motivated, asking Republican Rep. Michele Bachmann: 'Where was your outrage when Democrats criticized President Bush for similar executive orders?' He added, 'This is a waste of time. There are far more important issues to address.' Bachmann, however, contradicted Boehner’s stated intent, arguing instead for defunding the executive branch—and even impeachment. Cavuto responded sharply: 'The Democrats would laugh you out of the room.' The White House maintains the lawsuit will not consume its attention. Boehner, meanwhile, remains committed to moving forward.

Obama je rekao da je već razgovarao s tim republikancem i rekao mu: 'Ako zaista brineš što uzimaš previše izvršnih akcija, zašto ne pokušaš nešto postići putem Kongresa?' 'Hoćeš li se žaliti ako pokušam popraviti neke dijelove zakona administrativno—unutar mojih pravnih ovlasti—dok vi ne radite ništa?' rekao je Obama, pozivajući se na republikanske zastupnike u Domu. 'Neću se oprostiti što pokušavam djelovati dok vi sjedite neaktivni.' U srijedu je Boehner objavio da namjerava podnijeti tužbu protiv predsjednika Obame, navodeći niz zloupotreba izvršne vlasti. 'Ovo nije o impeachmentu,' insistirao je Boehner. 'Ovo je o osiguranju da predsjednik vjerno izvršava zakone ove zemlje.' 'U posljednjih pet godina jasno smo vidjeli pokušaj da se oslabi moć zakonodavne grane,' rekao je Boehner. 'Vjerujem da predsjednik ne vjerno izvršava zakone naše zemlje.' Bijela kuća je rekla da neće dopustiti da tužba ometa njihov rad. Obama je nastavio svoj raspored, održavajući govor o ekonomiji u Minneapolisu prije povratka u Washington. Obama je ponavljao svoju strategiju 'pera i telefona' kako bi promovirao svoju domaću agendu, posebno nakon što je Kongres bio neaktivan. U svom govoru o stanju saveza 2014. godine, proglasio je 2014. godinu 'godinom akcije.' Iako je Dom prihvatio zakone koji ograničavaju izvršne ovlasti predsjednika—navodeći da premašuju ustavne granice—predsjednik Senata Harry Reid smatrao ih je mrtvim na dolasku. Među najkontroverznijim izvršnim akcijama Obame su: povišenje minimalne plaće za kontraktore savezne vlade, odgađanje ključnih odredaba Zakona o pristupu zdravstvenoj zaštiti, postavljanje novih standarda potrošnje goriva za kamione i uputiti EPA-u da primjenjuje širok spektar pravila o emisiji ugljičnog dioksida u okviru njegovog Klimatskog plana djelovanja—što kritičari nazivaju 'uništavateljem uglja' zbog njegovog utjecaja na termoelektrane. Ali najspornija akcija za Boehnerovu frakciju, prema izvorima s Kapitola, je Obamaova 2012. godine politika DACA kojom je odgođena deportacija stotina tisuća nelegalnih doseljenika koje su doveli u SAD kao djecu. Republikanci tvrde da je ta politika potaknula talas nepratnog djeteta koje prelazi južnu granicu, opterećujući resurse vlade i izazivajući humanitarnu krizu. Boehner još nije precizirao koje izvršne akcije će izazvati u sudu. 'Kada donesem odluku, reći ću vam,' rekao je novinarima. Izložio je svoje namjere u memorandumu republikanskim zastupnicima i potvrdio svoju obvezu na zatvorenoj sastanku. Tužba, ako se provede, biti će podnijeta od strane cijelog Domа predstavnika, zahtijevajući odobrenje Bipartizanske pravne savjetodavne grupe (BLAG)—skupine sastavljene od Boehnera, predsjednika većine Kevin McCarthy, zamjenika većine Steve Scalise, predsjednika manjine Nancy Pelosi i zamjenika manjine Stenya Hoya. Jednostavna većina glasova, vjerojatno 3-2, autorizirala bi tužbu. Tajnik za javne odnose Bijele kuće Josh Earnest kritizirao je republikance zbog blokiranja, rekavši da su ostavili Obamu bez izbora osim korištenja izvršnih ovlasti. 'Činjenica da razmišljaju o tužbi na trošak porezoplatitelja protiv predsjednika Sjedinjenih Američkih Država jer radi svoj posao—mislim da većina Amerikanaca to ne bi podržala,' rekao je Earnest. Boehnerov tajnik Michael Steel odgovorio je: 'Američki narod, njihovi izabrani zastupnici i Vrhovni sud su svi izrazili ozbiljne zabrinutosti zbog predsjednikove neosposobljenosti da prati Ustav. Zanemarivanje njih riječima kao što je 'prikaz' samo pojačava njihovu frustraciju.' Voditelj Fox News Neil Cavuto nazvao je tužbu politički motiviranom, pitajući republikanku Michele Bachmann: 'Gdje je vaš bijes kad su demokrate kritizirale predsjednika Bushe za slične izvršne naredbe?' Dodao je: 'Ovo je gubitak vremena. Postoji mnogo važnijih stvari koje morate riješiti.' Bachmann, međutim, suprotstavila se Boehnerovoj izjavi, argumentirajući umjesto toga za otkazivanje izvršne vlasti—pa čak i za impeachment. Cavuto je odgovorio oštro: 'Demokrati bi vas nasmijali iz dvorane.' Bijela kuća održava da tužba neće ometati njihov rad. Boehner, međutim, ostaje zadržan na pokretanju procesa.

article_content: An Austrian woman, Susanne Mayr, faces the death penalty in Indonesia after being caught with 3kg (6.6 lbs) of crystal methamphetamine hidden in her suitcase. The 29-year-old dancer and charity worker claims she was deceived by a manager who promised her a performing career — but instead concealed drugs in the lining of a new suitcase provided to her. Mayr was on an all-expenses-paid trip to South Africa when her manager instructed her to travel to Indonesia and acquire new luggage. He took her to a shop where a suitcase was purchased, allegedly containing hidden compartments. From jail, Mayr contacted her mother, Ingeborg, in Baden, Lower Austria, saying, 'Mummy, you’ve got to help me. They’re going to shoot me.' Her mother explained that Mayr, known professionally as 'Young Bebe,' had built a following online and had long dreamed of working in Africa. She regularly donated earnings from dancing to support a school project in the region. Indonesian authorities consider drug smuggling of more than 3kg a capital offense. Mayr has reportedly cooperated with investigators, but the quantity of drugs involved makes a death sentence likely if convicted. Austrian officials are covering approximately $50,000 in legal fees to defend her. article_content: Rafael Nadal has confessed to feeling frightened when a masked protester sprinted onto the court during the French Open final, waving a flare — briefly interrupting his historic pursuit of an unprecedented eighth title. The Spanish tennis star, now the first man in history to win a Grand Slam singles title eight times, commended security staff for their swift response, removing the intruder late in the second set of his dominant 6-3, 6-2, 6-3 victory over fellow Spaniard David Ferrer. According to CNN affiliate BFM, the protester belonged to a group called Printemps Français (French Spring), which opposes France’s recent legalization of same-sex marriage. A second individual, shirtless, was also intercepted before reaching the court. 'I was scared at first — everything happened so fast,' the 27-year-old told CNN. 'I saw someone approaching with fire, and I couldn’t tell what was happening. These things are impossible to anticipate. I just want to thank the security team — they did an incredible job. I felt safe right away.' The disruption echoed past tennis scandals, including Monica Seles’ 1993 stabbing at the Hamburg Masters and a 2009 incident at Roland Garros when a spectator tried to place a red hat on Roger Federer’s head during the final. Nadal’s win extended his remarkable clay-court dominance at Roland Garros to 59 victories and just one loss — a 2009 defeat to Sweden’s Robin Soderling. After winning the 2012 title, Nadal spent seven months sidelined due to a severe right knee injury. 'So many people helped me and believed in me,' Nadal said. 'I received hundreds of messages filled with encouragement. That positive energy got me here — this trophy belongs to them.' In other tennis news, Dutch player Yannick Ebbinghaus has been handed a six-month suspension and a $10,000 fine for illegally betting on 67 matches between May 2012 and February 2013. The Tennis Integrity Unit (TIU) strictly prohibits players from wagering on matches. Three months of the ban are suspended pending completion of anti-corruption training, and half the fine may be refunded if Ebbinghaus, currently ranked 1,158th, fully cooperates with investigators. Meanwhile, Russian player Sergei Krotiouk, ranked 806th, was issued a lifetime ban last week for match-fixing.

article_content: After more than five years in detention, two Iranian men have been released from a prison in Iraq formerly operated by U.S. forces and are now en route home. According to officials at the Iranian Embassy in Baghdad, Ahmed Barazandeh and Ali Abdolmaleki were arrested during religious pilgrimages—Barazandeh in 2004 near Samarra after straying from his group, and Abdolmaleki in 2007 for lacking a valid passport upon entry into Iraq. The U.S. military confirmed transferring both men to Iraqi custody in 2009, following procedures outlined in the 2008 bilateral security pact between Iraq and the United States. Iranian authorities insist their detention was unjustified, calling the charges baseless and stressing that both men were simply pilgrims visiting holy sites. While many have speculated whether this release was part of a broader prisoner swap—especially amid ongoing appeals by the mothers of three American hikers held in Iran—Iranian officials have explicitly denied any connection between the two situations. Meanwhile, a recent exchange between France and Iran involving a detained Frenchwoman and a long-imprisoned Iranian man has fueled further speculation, though no official link has been established.

article_content: Archaeologists believe they may have discovered the world’s oldest known depiction of spiders. A highly unusual rock carving, interpreted as depicting arachnids, was found on the west wall of a sandstone valley in Egypt’s Kharga Oasis. It is believed to have been carved around 4,000 BC by prehistoric people, though the identification remains tentative and the purpose unclear. The rock panel — now fragmented into two pieces — shows several spider-like figures and a web adjacent to the leftmost figure. Additional enigmatic lines may represent insects caught in the web, plants, or strands of silk, according to Professor Salima Ikram, an Egyptologist at the American University in Cairo and co-director of the North Kharga Oasis Survey Project. Discovered in the desert approximately 108 miles (175 km) west of Luxor, the panel is positioned to be illuminated by the morning sun — a feature that may hold symbolic importance. Ikram told LiveScience the find is 'very unusual.' 'If these are indeed spiders,' she wrote in the journal Sahara, 'they would be unique representations of such creatures in Old World rock art.' Notably, a detached fragment of the panel depicts what appears to be a harvestman — an arachnid drawn in a distinctly different style from the other figures. Spiders are rarely depicted in ancient Egyptian art. The only known hieroglyphic references to spiders appear in religious texts describing the 'opening of the mouth' ritual, performed on mummies to restore senses for the afterlife. Arachnologist Hisham El-Hennawy suggests the Argiope lobata spider — common in Egypt’s western and eastern deserts and known to bask in the center of its orb web — may have inspired the carving. He proposes these spiders, thriving under intense sunlight, could have been seen as symbols of resilience and divine power: 'This would combine the force of the sun and the ability of this solar creature to survive its heat successfully, and thus be worthy of reverence or totemic allegiance.' One theory posits the images served as a warning, since some spiders can deliver painful bites. Alternatively, Ikram notes, someone may simply have admired spiders and carved them for no deeper reason.

Smatra se da je izrezana oko 4.000. godine prije nove ere od strane prapovijesnih ljudi, iako je identifikacija još uvijek sumnjiva, a svrha nepoznata. Kameni panel — koji je sada razbijen na dva dijela — prikazuje nekoliko figura sličnih paukima i mrežu uz lijevu figuru. Dodatne zagonetne linije mogu predstavljati insekte zarobljene u mreži, biljke ili niti svile, prema profesoru Salimi Ikram, egiptologinja sa Američkog univerziteta u Kairu i suradnici direktora Projekta istraživanja sjeverne oaze Kharga. Otkriven u pustinji otprilike 175 km zapadno od Luxora, panel je pozicioniran tako da ga obasjava jutarnje sunce — osobina koja može imati simboličku važnost. Ikram je rekla LiveScienceu da je ovo otkriće 'veoma neobično'. 'Ako su zaista paukovi,' napisala je u časopisu Sahara, 'to bi bili jedinstveni prikazi takvih bića u kamenoj umjetnosti Starog svijeta.' Zanimljivo, odvojeni komad panela prikazuje ono što izgleda kao harvesman — arahnidu izrađenu drugačijim stilom od ostalih figura. Paukovi rijetko su prikazivani u antičkoj egipatskoj umjetnosti. Jedini poznati hijeroglifski spomeni pauka pojavljuju se u religijskim tekstovima koji opisuju 'otvaranje usta' rituel, koji se vršio na mumijama kako bi se vratile senze za život poslije smrti. Arhaknolog Hisham El-Hennawy sugerira da je pauk Argiope lobata — koji živi u zapadnoj i istočnoj pustinji Egipta i poznat je po tome što se greje u sredini svoje kružne mreže — mogao biti inspiracija za ovu klesaninu. On predlaže da su ti paukovi, koji uspješno preživljavaju jaku toplinu sunca, mogli biti vidjeni kao simboli otpornosti i božanske moći: 'To bi spojilo snagu sunca i sposobnost ovog solarnog bića da uspješno preživi njegovu toplinu, te time bilo dostojno poštovanja ili totemskog poštovanja.' Jedna teorija predlaže da su ovi prikazi služili kao upozorenje, jer neki paukovi mogu ugrizati ljude, što bi predstavljalo prijetnju prapovijesnim ljudima. Alternativno, Ikram napominje da netko jednostavno može voljeti pauke i isklesati njihove slike bez namjere da imaju dublji smisao.

article_content: The state pension age should rise to 70 by 2040 — more than two decades earlier than currently planned — according to Britain’s former pensions chief, Lord Adair Turner. Currently, women could claim their state pension at 60, while men became eligible at 65. Government policy has already set a path to equalize and raise these ages: women’s pension age reached 65 by 2018; both genders will reach 66 by 2020, 67 by 2028, 68 by the mid-2030s, and 69 by the late 2040s. Experts estimate that, based on rising life expectancy, the state pension age will naturally reach 70 around 2063. But Lord Turner argues this timeline should be accelerated. Speaking at an event hosted by the think tank Policy Exchange, Turner, former chairman of the Pensions Commission and the Financial Services Authority, said: 'I think 70 by 2040 would be a good thing to aim for.' He also made a case for mandatory pension contributions, noting that while employers are required to contribute to workplace pensions, employees can opt out. 'There is a case for compulsion,' he stated. However, Turner emphasized that compulsion is only acceptable if excessive pension fees are abolished. 'We cannot compel people to save and then charge them one percent in fees. You’ve got to get fees lower than that.' Turner argued that working longer is often beneficial: 'For most people, leaving the workforce too early is a bad idea. People need the social interaction of work.' He added, 'I believe 60 is the new 40.' David Robbins, senior consultant at Towers Watson, noted that delaying pension claims by two years saves roughly £15,000 per person and boosts tax revenue through extended employment. A Department for Work and Pensions spokesperson reaffirmed the government’s commitment to making the state pension system sustainable, highlighting existing plans to reach age 68 and a built-in mechanism for future reviews based on life expectancy and other factors.

Trenutno, žene su mogle da traže svoju državnu penziju na 60. godini, dok su muškarci postali kvalifikovani na 65. Vlada je već usvojila plan da se ove starosne granice izjednače i povećaju: starosna granica za žene dostigla je 65 do 2018. godine; oba pola će dostići 66 do 2020. godine, 67 do 2028., 68 do sredine 2030-ih i 69 do kasnih 2040-ih. Stručnjaci procjenjuju da, uzimajući u obzir rastuću životnu dob, starosna granica za penziju prirodno dostiže 70 godina oko 2063. Ali lord Turner smatra da bi ovaj raspored trebalo ubrzati. Govoreći na događaju organizovanom od strane misliškog centra Policy Exchange, Turner, bivši predsjednik Penzionog komisije i Finansijske nadzorne vlasti, rekao je: 'Mislim da bi 70 do 2040. bilo dobra stvar za ciljanje.' On je također iznio argument za obavezan doprinos u penzioni fondove, primjećujući da iako su poslodavci dužni da doprinose radnim mjestima, radnici mogu da se odreknu. 'Postoji osnova za obavezu,' rekao je. Međutim, Turner je naglasio da je obaveza prihvatljiva samo ako se uklone prekomjerne naknade za penzije. 'Ne možemo prisiliti ljude da štede, a zatim naplaćivati im jedan posto naknade. Morate svesti naknade ispod te vrijednosti.' Turner je tvrdio da je rad kasnije u životu često koristan: 'Za većinu ljudi, napuštanje radnog mjesta previše rano je loša ideja. Ljudi trebaju socijalnu interakciju rada.' article_content: The parents of two-year-old Indie Smith, who has a rare blood disorder called atypical Haemolytic Uraemic Syndrome (aHUS), are urging the UK government to fund access to Soliris — a life-saving drug that has dramatically improved her health. Only around 140 people in the UK have this condition, and Soliris is the only proven and safe treatment available. However, it costs up to £250,000 per patient annually. Indie was among a small group of patients receiving Soliris through a temporary clinical trial funded by the drug’s American manufacturer. The trial is set to end in October, and the drug is not currently available through the NHS. Without continued access, her prognosis is uncertain. Her mother, Clare Smith, 36, and father, Gavin Smith, 40, a heating engineer from Chelmsford, Essex, say Indie transformed within two days of her first dose. 'Before that, she wasn’t with us at all,' Clare said. 'Within two days, she started to become normal again.' Although the Advisory Group for National Specialised Services (AGNSS) recommended approving Soliris for NHS use last year, the government referred the decision to the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE). NICE currently has no established process to evaluate drugs for ultra-rare conditions like aHUS. Professor Tim Goodship of Newcastle University noted that ministers’ main concern is affordability. NHS Specialised Services commissions treatments for rare diseases to prevent individual hospitals from being overwhelmed by the high costs of treating small patient populations. A Department of Health spokesperson stated: 'We need to make sure NHS resources are used wisely.'

Samo oko 140 ljudi u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu ima ovu bolest, a Soliris je jedini dokazano siguran i učinkovit tretman. Međutim, košta do 250.000 funti godišnje po pacijentu. Indie je bila među malom skupinom pacijenata koji su primali Soliris kroz privremeno kliničko ispitivanje koje su financirali američki proizvođači lijeka. Ispitivanje treba završiti u listopadu, a lijek trenutno nije dostupan putem NHS-a. Bez nastavka pristupa, njezin je prognoza nesigurna. Njezina majka, Clare Smith, 36, i otac, Gavin Smith, 40, toplinsko-inženjer iz Chelmsforda u Essexu, kažu da se Indie promijenila unutar dva dana nakon prve doze. 'Prije toga, nije bila s nama,' rekla je Clare. 'Unutar dva dana, počela je opet postati normalna.' Iako je Savjetodavna grupa za nacionalne specijalizirane usluge (AGNSS) preporučila odobravanje Solirisa za upotrebu u NHS-u prošle godine, vlada je odluku preusmjerila na Nacionalni institut za zdravstvenu negu i izvrsnost (NICE). NICE trenutno nema uspostavljen proces za procjenu lijekova za vrlo rijetke bolesti poput aHUS-a. Profesor Tim Goodship s Sveučilišta u Newcastleu napomenuo je da je glavna briga ministara njegova pristupačnost. NHS Specialised Services naručuje liječenje za rijetke bolesti kako bi spriječio pojedinačne bolnice da budu preopterećene visokim troškovima liječenja malih brojeva pacijenata iz vlastitih sredstava. Predstavnik Ministarstva zdravstva rekao je: 'Moramo osigurati da se resursi NHS-a koriste mudro.'

article_content: Lisa Smith doesn’t experience sexual attraction — and she’s openly searching for a partner who understands that. On ITV’s This Morning, she shared her story with Ruth Langsford and Eamonn Holmes, explaining that while she longs for deep emotional bonds, cuddles, and even marriage, sex itself feels deeply unappealing to her. It’s not a choice; it’s simply how she’s wired. Her first sexual encounter, with someone she loved and trusted, felt less like intimacy and more like an obligation. 'I didn’t want to do it,' she said. 'It was something I thought I had to go through to prove I was normal.' Even after trying to overcome her discomfort, nothing changed — sex never brought her pleasure, only unease. Every partner she’s been with has been patient and respectful, never pressuring her. Still, the emotional weight of trying to meet societal expectations took its toll. 'They wanted to make me happy,' she said. 'But I couldn’t give them what they expected — and that hurt us both.' Psychologist Emma Kelly pointed out that asexuality affects about one in every hundred people in the UK — far more common than most realize. Yet many still believe asexual people just haven’t met the right person, or that it’s a phase. Lisa rejects these myths outright. 'I’m not broken. I’m not hiding. I just don’t feel it.' Now, she dreams of a quiet life: a home, a spouse, maybe a cat or two. 'I want to settle down — just not in the way everyone assumes,' she joked. 'I’m an asexual vegan who doesn’t want kids. Yeah, I’m aware I sound like a stereotype.' Though she’s received heartfelt support from the asexual community — especially from AVEN — she’s also faced cruel messages like, 'No man will ever want you.' But Lisa remains hopeful. 'There are people who can’t have sex for medical reasons and still have fulfilling relationships. Why shouldn’t it be the same for me?' She’s clear: if a future partner wants sex, she’ll be honest from day one. 'I won’t pretend. If they ask me to change, I’d lose respect for them — and myself.'
translated_content: Liza Smit ne iskusi seksualnu privlačnost — i otvoreno traži partnera koji to razumije. Na ITV-ovom This Morningu, podijelila je svoju priču s Rut Lengsford i Eamon Holmes, objašnjavajući da iako želi duboke emocionalne veze, grljenje i čak brak, sam akt seksa osjeća duboko neprijatno. To nije izbor; to je jednostavno način na koji je programirana. Njen prvi seksualni susret, sa nekim koga je voljela i kojem je vjerovala, bio je više obaveza nego intimnost. 'Ne željela sam to učiniti,' rekla je. 'To je bilo nešto što sam mislila da moram proći kako bih dokazala da sam normalna.' Čak i nakon pokušaja da prekorači svoj nelagodni osjećaj, ništa se nije promijenilo — seks joj nikada nije donio zadovoljstvo, samo nesuglasice. Svaki njen partner bio je strpljiv i poštovan, nikada je nije pritisnuo. Ipak, emocionalna težina pokušaja da ispuni društvene očekivanja bila je velika. 'Željeli su me učiniti sretnom,' rekla je. 'Ali ja nisam mogla dati ono što su očekivali — i to nam je štetilo.' Psiholog Emma Kelly napomenula je da aseksualnost zahvaća otprilike jednog od svakih stotinu ljudi u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu — mnogo češće nego što većina misli. Međutim, mnogi još uvijek vjeruju da su aseksualni ljudi jednostavno naisli na pogrešnog partnera ili da je to prolazna faza. Liza odbacuje ove mitove. 'Nisam pokvarena. Ne sakrivam se. Jednostavno to ne osjećam.' Sada sniva o tihoj životnoj priči: kući, supružniku, možda mački. 'Želim se naseliti — ali ne onako kako svi pretpostavljaju,' smijala se. 'Ja sam aseksualna veganica koja ne želi djecu. Da, znam da zvučim kao stereotip.' Iako je primila srdačnu podršku od aseksualne zajednice — posebno od AVEN-a — nailazila je i na žestoke komentare poput: 'Nikad nećeš pronaći muškarca.' Ali Liza ostaje nadeća. 'Postoje ljudi koji zbog medicinskih razloga ne mogu imati seks i ipak imaju ispunjavajuće odnose. Zašto ne bi isto vrijedilo i za mene?' Jasna je: ako budući partner želi seks, bit će iskrena od prvog dana. 'Neću laži. Ako me traže da se promijenim, gubit ću poštovanje prema njima — i sebi.'

article_content: Atlanta, Georgia (CNN) — A Kuwaiti logistics firm, Public Warehousing Company KSC (PWC), has been indicted on multiple federal charges related to fraud in U.S. military food contracts across the Middle East. Authorities announced the indictment on Monday, alleging the company systematically inflated prices and submitted false claims to overcharge the U.S. government for meals provided to troops in Iraq, Kuwait, and Jordan. PWC, also known as Agility, received contracts in May 2003, February 2005, and July 2005 worth more than $8.5 billion. According to the six-count indictment filed in the Northern District of Georgia, the company violated the False Claims Act by billing for fresh produce at inflated rates and failing to pass along discounts and rebates it received from suppliers — as required under its contracts. The case stems from a 2005 whistleblower lawsuit filed by Kamal Mustafa al-Sultan, owner of a Kuwaiti company that previously partnered with PWC to bid on the contracts. The lawsuit remained sealed while federal investigators — including the FBI, Defense Criminal Investigative Service, Army Criminal Investigation Command, and the Defense Contract Audit Agency — built their case. Acting U.S. Attorney F. Gentry Shelnutt called the allegations a 'multiyear probe into abuses in vendor contracts,' adding that PWC 'manipulated prices to overcharge for food.' The Justice Department confirmed it joined the whistleblower suit after concluding its investigation. Though the exact amount of alleged fraud remains undisclosed pending ongoing investigations, officials emphasized the severity of betraying the trust placed in contractors supporting U.S. forces. Brig. Gen. Rodney Johnson of the Army CID stated, 'The defendants, tempted by monetary gain, betrayed the trust invested in them by the U.S. Army and now they must face the consequences.' PWC has not responded to requests for comment.
translated_content: Atlanta, Džordžija (CNN) — Kuvejtска логистичка фирма Паблик Варехаусинг Компани КСЦ (ПВК) је оптужена за више федералних кривичних оптужби повезаних са преваром у уговорима о храни за америчке трупе на Блиском истоку. Оптужнице су објављене у понедељак, а наводи се да је компанија систематски повећавала цене и подносила лажна тражења да би прекорачила износ који је требало да плати америчка влада за храну за војнике у Ираку, Кувајту и Јордану. ПВК, позната и као Agility, добила је уговоре у мају 2003. године, фебруару 2005. и јулу 2005. године вредне више од 8,5 милијарди долара. Према шестотачковној оптужници поднетој у Северном округу Џорџије, компанија је прекршила Закон о лажним тражењима тако што је наплаћивала по повећаним ценама за свеже воће и поврће и не предавала попусте и враћене суме које је добила од достављача — како је то било обавезно по уговорима. Поступак потиче из тужбе осетљивог информатора из 2005. године поднете од стране Камала Мустафе ал-Султана, власника kuvejtске фирме која је претходно сарађивала са ПВК-ом да би поднела понуду за уговоре. Тужба је остала у тајности док су федерални истражитељи — укључујући ФБИ, Дирекцију за кривичне истраге одбране, Команду кривичних истрага армије и Агенцију за аудит одбране — грађали случај. Повремени амерички тужилац Ф. Гентри Шелнат је називао оптужбе 'вишегодишњом истрагом у вези са злостављањима у уговорима о достављачима', додајући да је ПВК 'манипулисала цене како би прекорачила износ за храну.' Министарство правде је потврдило да се придружило тужби осетљивог информатора након завршетка истраге. Иако тачан износ наводне преваре остаје непознат због тренутне истраге, званичници су нагласили тешкоћу предаје поверења које је дато договорима који подржавају америчке снаге. Генерал-потпуковник Родни Џонсон из команде кривичних истрага армије рекао је: 'Оптужени, привлечени новчаним добитком, предали су поверење које им је дала америчка армија и сада морају да се суоче са последицама.' ПВК није одговорио на захтеве за коментар.

article_content: On Sunday, a heated confrontation unfolded on Brisbane’s Corso in Yeronga, south of the city, when a cyclist reportedly became enraged after claiming a passing car had driven too close to him. According to witnesses and police, the man stopped his bike directly in front of the vehicle, blocking its path. He then approached the car and asked the occupants to roll down their window, escalating the situation with verbal accusations. In a dramatic turn, the cyclist opened the rear door of the car, removed a laptop from the back seat, and hurled it onto the road. Fortunately, the device was not damaged. The car’s passengers, shaken but unharmed, filed a formal complaint with authorities. Police have since released a photo of the suspect — a man wearing a bright fluorescent jacket, fold-up jeans, gloves, a backpack, sunglasses, and a helmet — and are urging anyone with information to come forward. The incident has sparked local concern over road etiquette and cyclist-driver tensions.

article_content: During Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal’s visit to Tesla’s Fremont manufacturing plant, he expressed delight at seeing Indian engineers and financial experts holding key positions—and at the increasing role of Indian auto parts manufacturers in Tesla’s global supply chain. Although he missed meeting CEO Elon Musk in person, Goyal publicly wished him a swift recovery and acknowledged his influential presence. Musk responded warmly, thanking Goyal for visiting and apologizing for his absence, expressing hope to meet soon. Goyal also noted that Tesla is on track to nearly double its component imports from India, a development he called a milestone for Indian industry. Meanwhile, Musk reiterated his intention to visit India next year, citing a productive conversation with Prime Minister Narendra Modi earlier this year. He credited Modi’s encouragement as instrumental in accelerating Tesla’s plans to enter the Indian market, recalling their 2015 meeting at the same Fremont facility. Modi, in turn, posted on social media that their talk covered topics from clean energy to spiritual well-being, reinforcing mutual respect. As Goyal continues his U.S. trip to attend the IPEF and APEC summits, the exchange underscores deepening economic ties between India and global tech leaders.

article_content: Jacintha Saldanha, a 46-year-old nurse, tragically took her own life after being deceived by a prank phone call from Australian radio DJs posing as the Queen and Prince Charles. Her family honored her memory in a moving memorial service at Westminster Cathedral, describing her as a beacon of love, strength, and kindness. Her husband, Benedict Barboza, read a deeply personal tribute, calling her 'the light in my darkness' and expressing the unbearable emptiness left in their home and hearts. Their children, Junal and Lisha, shared heartfelt words, remembering her unwavering support, wisdom, and dedication to their education and well-being. Saldanha left three suicide notes: one expressing shame over being fooled, another detailing her funeral wishes for her hometown of Shirva in southwest India, and a third critically addressing the lack of emotional and institutional support she received from King Edward VII Hospital following the incident. The DJs responsible, Mel Greig and Michael Christian, publicly expressed shock and sorrow, acknowledging their actions triggered a tragedy they never anticipated. Their employer, Southern Cross Austereo, suspended all prank calls and launched a comprehensive review of its policies. King Edward VII Hospital issued a statement affirming that Saldanha was viewed as a victim of a cruel hoax and that no disciplinary action would be taken against her. However, her family remains deeply upset, demanding a full investigation into the hospital’s response to her distress. Memorials have been held in London, Bristol, and in Shirva, where her funeral is scheduled. Community vigils, including one by nursing students in Bangalore, reflect the global reach of her story and the profound impact of her loss.
translated_content: Džacintha Saldanha, 46-godišnja medicinska sestra, tragično je prekinula život nakon što je prevarana telefonskom šalom od australskih radijskih voditelja koji su se predstavljali kao kraljica i princ Čarls. Njezina obitelj počastila ju je u emotivnoj uspomeni na Westminsterskoj katedrali, opisujući je kao zraku ljubavi, snage i dobrote. Njezin muž, Benedikt Barboza, pročitao je duboko ličnu pohvalu, nazivajući je 'svjetlo u mojoj tami' i izrazio neizdrživu prazninu koju je ostavila u njihovom domu i srcima. Njezina djeca, Junal i Lisha, podijelila su srdačne riječi, podsjećajući na njezinu nepromjenjivu podršku, mudrost i posvećenost njihovom obrazovanju i dobrobiti. Saldanha je ostavila tri samoubojičke bilješke: jednu u kojoj izražava sramotu zbog prevari, drugu u kojoj detaljno opisuje želje za svojom sahranom u rodnom mjestu Shirva u jugozapadnoj Indiji, a treću kritički obrađuje nedostatak emocionalne i institucionalne podrške koju je primila od Bolnice kralja Eduarda VII nakon incidenta. Voditelji odgovorni za šalu, Mel Greig i Michael Christian, javno su izrazili šok i žalost, priznavši da su njihove akcije izazvale tragediju koju nikada nisu predvidjeli. article_content: By Louise Eccles, Claire Ellicott, and Jaya Narain. The mother of a disabled girl who died at age 11 is seeking compensation, claiming doctors failed to inform her of a significant risk that her unborn child might have a serious chromosomal abnormality. Joanne Chinnock says she would have terminated her pregnancy if she had been told there was a 1-in-13 chance of her baby being severely affected. Her daughter, Bethany Chinnock-Schumann, had an extremely rare chromosomal disorder that left her nearly blind and in almost constant pain. Bethany, born in 2001, lived with severe health challenges until her death in 2009. Her parents, Joanne Chinnock and Paul Schumann—both social workers experienced in supporting disabled individuals—cared for her around the clock. She required daily catheterization, feeding, medication, and frequent hospitalizations—including stays at Alder Hey, Great Ormond Street, and Cardiff’s children’s hospitals. In 2001, the couple attempted to sue Liverpool Women’s Hospital NHS Trust for wrongful birth but were advised by legal experts to drop the case, believing it lacked sufficient grounds. Now, they are suing the law firm Veale Wasbrough and barrister Karen Rea for professional negligence, alleging that their former legal team ignored critical medical facts and dismissed the couple’s clear intent to end the pregnancy if a serious disability was confirmed. At 11 weeks, Joanne underwent a routine nuchal translucency scan, which revealed increased fluid behind the baby’s neck—a 'soft marker' for potential chromosomal issues. However, she was not informed that, when combined with other factors, this indicated a 1-in-13 risk of trisomy. Doctors also failed to offer fetal echocardiography at 15 and 20 weeks, which could have confirmed the diagnosis. Michael Redfern QC, representing the couple, argued that Joanne repeatedly expressed to medical staff that she would not continue the pregnancy if a severe disability was confirmed. He called the failure to provide adequate information and testing 'indefensible.' Veale Wasbrough denies negligence, stating that experts were given full information and that the claim against them was filed too late. They also assert that Paul Schumann was never their client and therefore owed no duty of care. The judge, Mr Justice Dingemans, has reserved judgment. 'Wrongful birth' claims—where parents allege they were deprived of the chance to abort due to medical negligence—have cost the NHS approximately £54 million over the past five years.

Njeni roditelji, Džoan Činkok i Pol Šuman—oba socijalna radnika sa iskustvom u podršci osobama sa invaliditetom—brinuli su se o njoj cijelo vrijeme. Sada traže naknadu od pravne kuće Veale Wasbrough i od odvjetnice Karene Rea zbog profesionalne neopreznosti, tvrdeći da su njihovi prethodni pravni zastupnici zanemarili ključne medicinske činjenice i ignorisali jasnu namjeru para da prekine trudnoću ako bi potvrđena bila ozbiljna invalidnost. On je nazvao ovo zanemarivanje informacija i testiranja 'nedopustivim.' Veale Wasbrough poriče neoprez, navodeći da su stručnjaci dobili sve informacije i da je tužba protiv njih podignuta prekasno. Također tvrde da je Pol Šuman nikad bio njihov klijent i da im nisu dužni brigu. Sudija, g. Sudija Dingemens, je odgodio presudu. 'Pogrešno rođenje' tužbe su one gdje roditelji tvrde da su im oduzeta prilika da prekinu trudnoću zbog medicinske nepravilnosti. One su koštale NHS-a oko 54 miliona funti u posljednjih pet godina.
